title.raw: 卷一百三十五 志第八十八 樂十 Volume 135 Treatises 88: Music 10

translations.literal: Music 10
translations.idiomatic: Music 10

translations.literal: (Hymn Section Four)
translations.idiomatic: (Musical Section Four)

sentences.zh: ○朝謁玉清昭應宮太清宮朝享景靈宮封禪祀汾陰奉天書祭九鼎真宗奉聖祖玉清昭應宮御製十一首降聖，《真安》

translations.literal: ○ Court audience at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace, the Supreme Clarity Palace, and court offerings at the Spectacular Spirits Palace; feng and shan sacrifices, offerings at Fen-yin, presenting the Heavenly Book, sacrificing to the Nine Cauldrons; eleven hymns imperially composed by Emperor Zhenzong for venerating the Sacred Ancestor at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace: Descent of the Sage, 《True Peace》
translations.idiomatic: ○ For court audiences at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace and Supreme Clarity Palace, court offerings at the Spectacular Spirits Palace, the fengshan rites, offerings at Fen-yin, presentation of the Heavenly Book, and sacrifice to the Nine Cauldrons: eleven hymns composed by Emperor Zhenzong for venerating the Sacred Ancestor at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace--Descent of the Sage, to the tune 《True Peace》

translations.literal: Towering is the true hall, splendid the extraordinary courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty stands the true palace, radiant the wondrous court.

translations.literal: In scale it matches the Great Purple; bright and glowing in cinnabar and green.
translations.idiomatic: Its proportions rival the highest heaven, blazing with red and green pigments.

translations.literal: The primordial mandate is reverently answered; the great design is what is followed.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently answer the primal decree and uphold the grand design.

translations.literal: Many rites are performed in practice; the great response is formless.
translations.idiomatic: Countless ceremonies are fulfilled, and the mighty response lies beyond form.

translations.literal: Metal and stone are set forth everywhere; their sound reaches the distant dark.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and chimes are arrayed, and their sound carries into the deepest void.

translations.literal: Waiting as the whirlwind carriage returns, forever blessing the foundation and gate.
translations.idiomatic: We await the spirit carriage's return, that it may forever bless our foundation.

translations.literal: Offering incense, 《Spirit Peace》
translations.idiomatic: Offering incense, to the tune 《Spirit Peace》

translations.literal: Fragrant vapor rises and saturates above; the whirlwind carriage descends to approach.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant breath rises on high as the spirit carriage draws near from above.

translations.literal: Inheriting and continuing the great succession, forever spurring clarity and brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: We carry on the great line and forever strive for luminous discernment.

translations.literal: Misty vapor becomes fog; lush growth hangs down its shade.
translations.idiomatic: Incense mingles into mist as verdant shade spreads below.

translations.literal: Reverent and respectful in facing and responding, the border of blessing is what is revered.
translations.idiomatic: With reverent homage we respond, and gladly receive the blessings bestowed.

sentences.zh: 奉饌，《吉安》發祥有自，介福無疆。

translations.literal: Offering provisions, 《Auspicious Peace》: good fortune had a source; boundless blessing knows no limit.
translations.idiomatic: Offering sacred food, 《Auspicious Peace》: blessing arose from its source, and blessings extend without end.

translations.literal: Abundant and intertwined is the great response; protect and bless those below.
translations.idiomatic: Responses abound in profusion, blessing those beneath.

translations.literal: Fine offerings are now complete; elegant performance is fully raised.
translations.idiomatic: Fine offerings stand ready, and the elegant music fully resounds.

translations.literal: Diligent in awe, penetrating and reaching through; overseeing and beholding the bright rule.
translations.idiomatic: With reverent awe that pierces through, the overseeing gaze discerns the bright pattern.

sentences.zh: 玉皇位酌獻，《慶安》無體之體，強名之名。

translations.literal: Jade Emperor position libation offering, 《Celebratory Peace》: a formless form, a name forcibly named.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to the Jade Emperor, 《Celebratory Peace》: the form beyond form, the name imposed upon the nameless.

translations.literal: Overseeing and viewing the myriad lodges.
translations.idiomatic: Watching over all the dwellings of creation.

translations.literal: Governing and ruling the Nine Clarities.
translations.idiomatic: Ruling the nine realms of highest purity.

translations.literal: True term of protection and blessing; auspicious mandate brightly displayed.
translations.idiomatic: In truth may protection endure, and the auspicious mandate shine clear.

translations.literal: Diligent and cautious, reverently responding to the completion of bounty.
translations.idiomatic: With utmost diligence we reverently fulfill heaven's generous completion.

sentences.zh: 聖祖位酌獻，《慶安》於昭靈貺，誕啟鴻源。

translations.literal: Sacred Ancestor position libation offering, 《Celebratory Peace》: in the splendor of spiritual boons, birth opens the vast source.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to the Sacred Ancestor, 《Celebratory Peace》: in radiant signs of blessing, the great source was opened.

translations.literal: Merit aids the many categories; celebration flows to the later descendants.
translations.idiomatic: His merit sustained all living kinds, and blessings flow to generations unborn.

translations.literal: Orchid delicacies ascend the stands; cassia wine fills the goblets.
translations.idiomatic: Orchid meats grace the altar trays, and cassia wine brims the cups.

translations.literal: Bowing as the whirlwind carriage returns, forever sheltering the cloud descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Heeding the spirit carriage's return, he shelters his descendants forever.

translations.literal: Taizu position libation offering, 《Celebratory Peace》
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Taizu, 《Celebratory Peace》

translations.literal: Illustrious is the Accomplished Ancestor, receiving the mandate from the high vault.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid the founding ancestor, who received the mandate from highest heaven.

translations.literal: Majesty extends beyond the seas; influence saturates the region within.
translations.idiomatic: His might reached beyond the seas, and his transforming power suffused the realm.

translations.literal: Sending forth auspiciousness from the ancestral tablets, bestowing blessing to the young heir.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings arose from the ancestral shrine, and protection was granted to the tender young lord.

translations.literal: Reverently receiving accumulated virtue, spurring wings to refined devotion.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently inherit accumulated merit and strive with deepest sincerity.

sentences.zh: 太宗位酌獻，《慶安》明明文考，儲精上蒼。

translations.literal: Taizong position libation offering, 《Celebratory Peace》: bright and clear the cultural father, storing essence in the upper azure.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to Emperor Taizong, 《Celebratory Peace》: luminous the cultured father who stored his refined essence in heaven.

translations.literal: Rites and music clearly complete, broadly leading all to serve as guest and king.
translations.idiomatic: Rites and music stood complete and clear, leading all nations to pay homage.

translations.literal: Merit and virtue accumulate in harmony; the dynastic cycle meets flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and virtue joined in harmony, and the age's span met its flourishing.

translations.literal: Filial thought without limit; great blessing without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Filial longing knows no end, and great blessings know no bounds.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《衝安》太初非有體，至道本無聲。

translations.literal: Second and final offering, 《Tranquil Peace》: the Grand Beginning has no form; the utmost Way originally has no sound.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, 《Tranquil Peace》: the primordial has no body, and the supreme Way was soundless at its root.

sentences.zh: 降跡臨下土，成功陟上清。

translations.literal: Descending traces to approach the lower earth, successful accomplishment ascending to upper clarity.
translations.idiomatic: He descended to dwell upon the earth, and in success rose to highest purity.

sentences.zh: 至仁敦動植，丕緒啟宗祊。

translations.literal: Utmost benevolence thickens in what moves and what grows; great succession opens the ancestral shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme benevolence nurtured all that moves and grows, and the great line opened the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 紫禁承來格，鴻基保永寧。

translations.literal: The Purple Forbidden receives the coming presence; the vast foundation preserves eternal peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Forbidden City welcomes the divine descent, and the grand foundation secures lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 發祥垂誕告，致孝薦崇名。

translations.literal: Sending forth auspiciousness, bestowing birth announcement; achieving filiality, offering and recommending the exalted name.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings were proclaimed at his birth, and filial devotion lifts the honored name.

sentences.zh: 廣樂神欽奉，儲休固太平。

translations.literal: Broad music: the spirits reverently receive; stored blessings secure great peace.
translations.idiomatic: With grand music the spirits accept the offering, and stored blessings fortify great peace.

sentences.zh: 飲福，《慶安》明明始祖，誕啟慶基。

translations.literal: Receiving blessing, 《Celebratory Peace》: bright and clear the founding ancestor, birth opening the celebratory foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the blessing wine, 《Celebratory Peace》: luminous the founding ancestor who opened the blessed foundation.

translations.literal: Cautiously and carefully the later descendants, reverently presenting filial thought.
translations.idiomatic: Devoted descendants reverently uphold filial remembrance.

translations.literal: Refined purity thereby reached; blessings and fortune are all fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Through purity of offering blessing is attained, and all fortune accords with right.

translations.literal: Thereby to repay the boon, thereby to receive favor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we repay the gift and receive heaven's grace.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《吉安》雕俎在禦，飆駕聞聲。

translations.literal: Withdrawing the feast, 《Auspicious Peace》: carved stands are at the imperial presence; the whirlwind carriage hears the sound.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offerings, 《Auspicious Peace》: carved trays stand before the throne, and the spirit carriage heeds the sound.

translations.literal: The true traveler thereby descends; delicious wine thereby fills.
translations.idiomatic: The true spirit descends, and fine wine brims the cups.

translations.literal: Great music is said to cease; great rite is said to complete.
translations.idiomatic: Great music is now hushed, and the great rite is fulfilled.

translations.literal: Withdrawing those regular offerings, exhausting this bright sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: We withdraw the standing offerings and lay bare this lucid devotion.

translations.literal: Escorting the Sage, 《True Peace》
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the Sage, to the tune 《True Peace》

translations.literal: Refined mind has already reached; true traveler is indeed arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Refined devotion has been fulfilled, and the true spirit has duly arrived.

translations.literal: Ritual bearing is thereby raised; fortune's response is only rich.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual form is now performed, and the blessing received is full and pure.

translations.literal: About to arrange the immortal chariot, speaking of return to the upper sky.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit carriage is made ready for the return to highest heaven.

translations.literal: Forever preserving the fine boon, thereby to bring peace to the teeming people.
translations.idiomatic: May the blessed gift endure, bringing peace to all the people.

translations.literal: Welcoming and presenting the sacred image, four hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Four hymns for welcoming and presenting the sacred images.

translations.literal: (All employ 《Celebratory Peace》)
translations.idiomatic: (All use the tune 《Celebratory Peace》)

translations.literal: Jade Emperor position
translations.idiomatic: At the Jade Emperor's place

translations.literal: Jade Void Supreme Emperor, golden image countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Emperor of the Jade Void, in golden image and countenance.

translations.literal: Dwelling in truth, cloud structure; refining the sun, turtle follows.
translations.idiomatic: Abiding in truth within a cloud-built hall, refining the sun with the tortoise in train.

translations.literal: Only the emperor faces and responds, leading rites with diligent respect.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor alone faces the spirits, leading the rites with reverent diligence.

translations.literal: Spirit mind greatly responds; fortune and emolument come to be honored.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit responds abundantly, and blessings and rank are heaped high.

sentences.zh: 聖祖位總化在天，保昌厥緒。

translations.literal: Sacred Ancestor position: overall transformation in heaven, preserving the flourishing of his succession.
translations.idiomatic: At the Sacred Ancestor's place: governing transformation in heaven, preserving the flourishing of his line.

translations.literal: Descending to the imperial apartments, jade wheel bearing the imperial.
translations.idiomatic: He descends to the imperial precinct, carried on a jade wheel chariot.

translations.literal: Embroidered banners arrayed like stars; countenance cast in gold.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered banners stand like stars, and the sacred likeness is cast in gold.

translations.literal: Bless our celebratory foundation, dwelling in this spirit hall.
translations.idiomatic: Bless our blessed foundation, that we may abide in this sacred palace.

sentences.zh: 太祖位烝哉大君，聿懷帝祖！

translations.literal: Taizu position: abundant, great lord, taking to heart the imperial ancestor!
translations.idiomatic: At Taizu's place: abundant is the great sovereign who holds the imperial ancestor in his heart!

translations.literal: Melting the mold for the true regalia, offering reverence in the spirit hall.
translations.idiomatic: The true likeness was cast in molten metal and enshrined in the spirit palace.

translations.literal: Utmost feeling auspiciousness opens; vast brilliance all things behold.
translations.idiomatic: At fullest devotion blessings unfold, and all beings witness the great radiance.

translations.literal: Gazing and attending with full respect; flying glory leads all the land.
translations.idiomatic: With fullest reverence we gaze and pay homage; his glory spreads across the land.

sentences.zh: 太宗位於顯神宗，德洽區中。

translations.literal: Taizong position: in displaying the spirit ancestor, virtue harmonizes the region within.
translations.idiomatic: At Taizong's place: manifesting the spirit ancestor, whose virtue pervaded the realm.

translations.literal: Auspicious metal sparkles in smelting, molding this countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious gold was smelted and cast into this sacred likeness.

translations.literal: Extraordinary court all as palace, preparing things to offer respect.
translations.idiomatic: In the wondrous court all is made ready, with every requisite offered in respect.

translations.literal: Bright majesty has brilliance; descending blessings come together.
translations.idiomatic: His luminous majesty shines forth, and blessings descend alike upon all.

sentences.zh: 玉清昭應宮上尊號三首

translations.literal: Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace, elevating honorific title, three hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Three hymns for bestowing the elevated honorific at the Jade Clarity Manifest Response Palace.

sentences.zh: 奉告，《隆安》登隆妙號，欽翼淵宗。

translations.literal: Presenting the announcement, 《Prosperous Peace》: ascending the lofty wondrous title, reverently winging the profound ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the announcement, 《Prosperous Peace》: the lofty honored title is proclaimed, reverently upholding the profound ancestor.

translations.literal: Abundant in displaying virtue and rites, with reverent bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Richly displaying virtuous rites, with solemn and reverent demeanor.

translations.literal: Presenting the jade tablet in ascending offering, hanging pendants with increasing respect.
translations.idiomatic: Raising the jade tablet in offering, girdle pendants swaying with deepest respect.

translations.literal: Raising blessings, chanting beauty, with intervals of pipes and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings are proclaimed in song, interspersed with pipes and bells.

translations.literal: Grand Beginning Hall, presenting registers and seals, 《Ascending Peace》
translations.idiomatic: At the Grand Beginning Hall, presenting the register and seals, 《Ascending Peace》

translations.literal: Imperial spirit bestows protection; vast fortune grows ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial spirit grants protection, and great blessings grow ever more abundant.

translations.literal: Reverently leading the far-reaching lodges, pure sacrifice to the true countenance.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently lead all the realm in pure sacrifice to the true likeness.

translations.literal: Solemn and respectful in presenting the register, facing and responding with pure person.
translations.idiomatic: With solemn reverence we present the register, facing the spirits in purity.

translations.literal: Countenance solemn and reverent; excellent title honored and revered.
translations.idiomatic: His countenance is solemn and still, and the excellent title is honored on high.

translations.literal: Rites at their height, music raised; fortune and emolument come together.
translations.idiomatic: Rites reach their fullness and music is raised, and blessings and rank descend alike.

translations.literal: Two Sages Hall, presenting the crimson gauze robe, 《Ascending Peace》
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of the Two Sages, presenting the crimson gauze robe, 《Ascending Peace》

translations.literal: Illustrious the successive sages; majesty and virtue tower high.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid the line of sages, whose majesty and virtue stand towering.

translations.literal: Red and glowing the spirit hall; regalia are there.
translations.idiomatic: Radiant the spirit palace, where the sacred regalia abide.

translations.literal: Presenting the dragon robe, covering with it the image of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon robe is offered, draped like the pattern of heaven.

translations.literal: Doubly celebrating the ancestral altars, for myriads upon myriads of years.
translations.idiomatic: May the state altars know redoubled joy for ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 太尉奉聖號冊寶，《真安》上旻降監，介祉實繁。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal presenting the sacred title register and seals, 《True Peace》: the upper sky descends to oversee; border blessings are truly abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Marshal presents the sacred title register and seals, 《True Peace》: heaven descends to oversee, and blessings abound without measure.

translations.literal: State and family cultivate repayment; wondrous Way returns to honor.
translations.idiomatic: The realm and the house fulfill their debt of gratitude, and the wondrous Way is honored on high.

translations.literal: Adding the name at the azure pole, presenting the register at the spirit pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The name is raised to heaven's height, and the register is presented at the spirit pavilion.

translations.literal: Abundantly proclaiming the sage canon, forever protecting the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: The sage canon is richly proclaimed, forever protecting all the people.

sentences.zh: 寶冊升殿，《大安》圖書昭錫，典禮紹成。

translations.literal: Treasured register ascends the hall, 《Great Peace》: charts and documents brightly bestowed; canonical rites continue and complete.
translations.idiomatic: The treasured register ascends the hall, 《Great Peace》: the written records are brightly granted, and the canonical rites are brought to completion.

translations.literal: How fortunate the teeming people; the teaching father stores the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: How blessed the people are, with the teaching father preserving the spirit.

translations.literal: Reverently receiving the great boon, reverently presenting the honored name.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently receive the great blessing and uphold the honored name.

translations.literal: Achieving reverence with the treasured register, bestowing protection on foundation and gate.
translations.idiomatic: With devout reverence we present the treasured register, that protection may bless our foundation.

sentences.zh: 降神，《真安》猶龍之聖，降生厲鄉。

translations.literal: Descending Spirit, 《True Peace》: like the sage of the dragon, born in Li Village.
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Spirit, 《True Peace》: like the dragon sage, born in Li Village.

translations.literal: Teaching flows in purity and stillness; the Way accords with vast obscurity.
translations.idiomatic: His teaching flows in clarity and stillness, and the Way accords with the vast unknown.

translations.literal: The great lord reverently attends; the grand ceremony is indeed fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The great sovereign attends in reverence, and the grand rite is wholly fitting.

translations.literal: Feathered guards arrayed in profusion; in person offering artemisia and iris.
translations.idiomatic: Feathered guards stand in dense array as he personally offers fragrant herbs.

translations.literal: Official regalia in abundance; bells and stones resound in splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Official regalia crowd the hall, and bells and stones sound in splendor.

translations.literal: The highest truth arrives and halts; border fortune brings auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: The highest spirit arrives, and blessings and fortune are born.

sentences.zh: 奉玉幣，《靈安》琳宮奕奕，黼坐煌煌。

translations.literal: Presenting jade disks, 《Spirit Peace》: the jade palace gleams, the embroidered seat glows.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade disks, 《Spirit Peace》: the jade palace shines bright, and the embroidered seat glows.

translations.literal: Jade and silk complete the rite; the whirlwind carriage extends auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silk fulfill the rite, and the spirit carriage extends blessing.

translations.literal: Grand ceremony has its norms; splendid fortune knows no bound.
translations.idiomatic: The grand rite has its norms, and splendid fortune knows no bounds.

translations.literal: Fine responses brightly accord; great design is thereby raised.
translations.idiomatic: Fine responses brightly accord, and the great design is raised on high.

translations.literal: Offering provisions, 《Auspicious Peace》
translations.idiomatic: Offering provisions, to the tune 《Auspicious Peace》

translations.literal: Metal music thereby harmonizes; the whirlwind traveler arrives at its place.
translations.idiomatic: Metal music harmonizes, and the spirit traveler takes his place.

translations.literal: Spirit oversight is brilliantly displayed; the imperial heart spurs its wings.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit oversight shines forth, and the imperial heart is spurred to diligence.

translations.literal: Solemnly presenting carved stands, coming to ascend the colored mats.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly presenting carved trays, ascending the colored mats.

translations.literal: Enjoying virtue with sincerity; coalesced blessing without satiety.
translations.idiomatic: Enjoying virtue with sincerity, blessings coalesce without end.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《大安》欽崇至道，肅謁殊庭。

translations.literal: Libation offering, 《Great Peace》: reverently honoring the utmost Way, reverently attending the extraordinary court.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Great Peace》: reverently honoring the supreme Way, reverently attending the wondrous court.

translations.literal: Following the wind in bowing; bright virtue is only fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Bowing with the wind, bright virtue is fragrant alone.

translations.literal: The whirlwind carriage comes to its place; honored wine thereby fills.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit carriage arrives, and honored wine brims the cups.

translations.literal: This is the libation, this is the offering; heart penetrates the distant dark.
translations.idiomatic: We pour and we offer, and the heart reaches the distant void.

sentences.zh: 飲福，《大安》彼渦之壤，指李之區。

translations.literal: Receiving blessing, 《Great Peace》: that land of the vortex, the district of Li.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the blessing wine, 《Great Peace》: that land of the whirlpool, the district of Li.

translations.literal: Thousands of chariots and ten thousand horsemen come to court the hidden capital.
translations.idiomatic: Thousands of chariots and myriad horsemen come to court the hidden capital.

translations.literal: In person presenting fragrant offerings, sincerely receiving the immortal carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In person he presents fragrant offerings and sincerely receives the spirit carriage.

translations.literal: Drinking wine and receiving fortune, forever shining upon the vast design.
translations.idiomatic: Drinking wine and receiving blessing, forever shining upon the grand design.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《正安》邈矣道祖，冥幾惚恍！

translations.literal: Second and final offering, 《Correct Peace》: remote is the Way's ancestor, dim and indistinct!
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, 《Correct Peace》: remote is the Way's ancestor, dim and indistinct!

translations.literal: Constant virtue does not depart; utmost truth has no image.
translations.idiomatic: Constant virtue never departs, and utmost truth has no form.

translations.literal: Drawing the position to the clear vault, descending blessing on the spirit soil.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing near the clear heaven, blessing descends upon the sacred ground.

translations.literal: Pouring sweet wine to offer sincerity, controlling the whirlwind to come and enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring sweet wine in sincere offering, guiding the spirit wind to come and partake.

translations.literal: Escorting the Spirit, 《True Peace》
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the Spirit, to the tune 《True Peace》

translations.literal: Sweet wine stands at the door; metal music sounds in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet wine stands at the door, and metal music sounds in the court.

translations.literal: Baskets and beans are performed; millet and glutinous millet are not fragrance alone.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and beans are set forth; grain alone is not the fragrance sought.

translations.literal: Righteousness exhausted in purity; sincerity penetrates the distant dark.
translations.idiomatic: Righteousness is fulfilled in purity, and sincerity reaches the distant void.

translations.literal: Speaking of the returning wind and four-horse team, blessing our extended years.
translations.idiomatic: As the spirit wind and chariot team return, may they bless our long years.

sentences.zh: 太極觀奉冊寶一首《登安之曲》

translations.literal: Supreme Ultimate Abbey presenting register and seals, one hymn: 《Ascending Peace Tune》
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for presenting the register and seals at the Supreme Ultimate Abbey: 《Ascending Peace Tune》

translations.literal: Recommending the title in the dark vault, raising the name at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The title is proclaimed in heaven's court, and the name is raised at the ancestral temple.

translations.literal: Ascending to match at the yang suburb, harmoniously displaying the canonical rite.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending to match at the southern suburb, harmoniously displaying the canonical rite.

translations.literal: Moved by lightning in the spirit realm, the sage's birth was vast and excellent.
translations.idiomatic: Moved by lightning in the spirit realm, the sage's birth was vast and excellent.

translations.literal: Register and seals are thereby displayed; fortune and emolument come together.
translations.idiomatic: The register and seals are displayed, and fortune and rank arrive together.

sentences.zh: 景靈宮奉冊寶一首《登安之曲》

translations.literal: Spectacular Spirits Palace presenting register and seals, one hymn: 《Ascending Peace Tune》
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for presenting the register and seals at the Spectacular Spirits Palace: 《Ascending Peace Tune》

translations.literal: Solemn and solemn True Zong, bestowing favor in abundant flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and solemn Emperor Zhenzong, bestowing favor in abundant flourishing.

translations.literal: Whirlwind wheel approaches with blessing; earnest instruction penetrates and displays.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit wheel approaches with blessing, and earnest instruction shines forth.

translations.literal: Reverently honoring the excellent title, reverently answering the splendid auspiciousness.
